ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white dominates the central field with a macro-ratio of approximately 65% high-intensity to 35% low-intensity black pixels located primarily at margins and the median base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobes exhibit high-intensity white fields. Low-intensity black mottling is concentrated at the peduncle junction and radiates upward in irregular streaks. Solid low-intensity banding is present along the entire trailing and leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 52 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; trailing edge exhibits continuous pixel-amplitude variations ranging from 2-8 pixels, with distinct jagged 'teeth' and multiple shallow U-shaped notches across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Geometric curve initiates with a strong convexity from the notch, transitioning to a shallow concave sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white circular pixel groups (barnacle scars) are localized at the terminal tips of both the left and right lobes, with secondary clusters along the upper-right trailing margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous low-intensity (dark) linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible; primary orientation is vertical/oblique, traversing the white ventral field on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel linear rake marks across the ventral surface and dense barnacle colonization/scarring on the lateral fluke tips.
